questions.question: What are the first name and last name of the players who have weight above 220 or height below 75?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT name_first ,  name_last FROM player WHERE weight  >  220 OR height  <  75

questions.question: Find the year in which the least people enter hall of fame.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT yearid FROM hall_of_fame GROUP BY yearid ORDER BY count(*) ASC LIMIT 1;

questions.question: How many players enter hall of fame each year?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT yearid ,  count(*) FROM hall_of_fame GROUP BY yearid;

questions.question: List the names of states that have more than 2 parks.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT state FROM park GROUP BY state HAVING count(*)  >  2;

questions.question: In which year did the least people enter hall of fame?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT yearid FROM hall_of_fame GROUP BY yearid ORDER BY count(*) ASC LIMIT 1;

questions.question: What were all the salary values of players in 2010 and 2001?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT salary FROM salary WHERE YEAR  =  2010 UNION SELECT salary FROM salary WHERE YEAR  =  2001

questions.question: How many games were played in city Atlanta in 2000?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM home_game AS T1 JOIN park AS T2 ON T1.park_id  =  T2.park_id WHERE T1.year  =  2000 AND T2.city  =  'Atlanta';

questions.question: Which 3 players won the most player awards? List their full name and id.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T1.name_first ,  T1.name_last ,  T1.player_id FROM player AS T1 JOIN player_award AS T2 ON T1.player_id  =  T2.player_id GROUP BY T1.player_id ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 3;

questions.question: What is the total salary paid by team Boston Red Stockings in 2010?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT sum(T1.salary) FROM salary AS T1 JOIN team AS T2 ON T1.team_id  =  T2.team_id_br WHERE T2.name  = 'Boston Red Stockings' AND T1.year  =  2010

questions.question: Count the number of times the team "Boston Red Stockings" lost in 2009 postseason.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM postseason AS T1 JOIN team AS T2 ON T1.team_id_loser  =  T2.team_id_br WHERE T2.name  =  'Boston Red Stockings' AND T1.year = 2009;

questions.question: What are the name and id of the team offering the lowest average salary?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T1.name ,  T1.team_id FROM team AS T1 JOIN salary AS T2 ON T1.team_id = T2.team_id GROUP BY T1.team_id ORDER BY avg(T2.salary) ASC LIMIT 1;

questions.question: What are the maximum scores the team Boston Red Stockings got when the team won in postseason?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT max(T1.wins) FROM postseason AS T1 JOIN team AS T2 ON T1.team_id_winner  =  T2.team_id_br WHERE T2.name  =  'Boston Red Stockings';

questions.question: How many parks are there in the state of NY?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM park WHERE state  =  'NY';

questions.question: Find the players' first name and last name who won award both in 1960 and in 1961.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T1.name_first , T1.name_last FROM player AS T1 JOIN player_award AS T2 WHERE T2.year  =  1960 INTERSECT SELECT T1.name_first , T1.name_last FROM player AS T1 JOIN player_award AS T2 WHERE T2.year  =  1961

questions.question: What are first and last names of players participating in all star game in 1998?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT name_first ,  name_last FROM player AS T1 JOIN all_star AS T2 ON T1.player_id  =  T2.player_id WHERE YEAR  =  1998

questions.question: Count the total number of games the team Boston Red Stockings attended from 1990 to 2000.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT sum(T1.games) FROM home_game AS T1 JOIN team AS T2 ON T1.team_id = T2.team_id_br WHERE T2.name = 'Boston Red Stockings' AND T1.year BETWEEN 1990 AND 2000;

questions.question: What is the average height of the players from the college named 'Yale University'?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT avg(T1.height) FROM player AS T1 JOIN player_college AS T2 ON T1.player_id  =  T2.player_id JOIN college AS T3 ON T3.college_id  =  T2.college_id WHERE T3.name_full  =  'Yale University';

questions.question: Compute the total salary that the player with first name Len and last name Barker received between 1985 to 1990.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT sum(T1.salary) FROM salary AS T1 JOIN player AS T2 ON T1.player_id = T2.player_id WHERE T2.name_first  =  'Len' AND T2.name_last = 'Barker' AND T1.year BETWEEN 1985 AND 1990;

questions.question: What is the number of wins the team Boston Red Stockings got in the postseasons each year in history?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT count(*) ,  T1.year FROM postseason AS T1 JOIN team AS T2 ON T1.team_id_winner  =  T2.team_id_br WHERE T2.name  =  'Boston Red Stockings' GROUP BY T1.year

questions.question: What are the first name and last name of the players who were paid salary by team Washington Nationals in both 2005 and 2007?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T2.name_first ,  T2.name_last FROM salary AS T1 JOIN player AS T2 ON T1.player_id = T2.player_id JOIN team AS T3 ON T3.team_id_br = T1.team_id WHERE T1.year = 2005 AND T3.name = 'Washington Nationals' INTERSECT SELECT T2.name_first , T2.name_last FROM salary AS T1 JOIN player AS T2 ON T1.player_id = T2.player_id JOIN team AS T3 ON T3.team_id_br = T1.team_id WHERE T1.year = 2007 AND T3.name = 'Washington Nationals'

questions.question: Which team had the least number of attendances in home games in 1980?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T2.name FROM home_game AS T1 JOIN team AS T2 ON T1.team_id = T2.team_id_br WHERE T1.year = 1980 ORDER BY T1.attendance ASC LIMIT 1;

questions.question: How many players did Boston Red Stockings have in 2000?

questions.question: List the maximum scores of the team Boston Red Stockings when the team won in postseason?

questions.question: How many games in total did team Boston Red Stockings attend from 2000 to 2010?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT sum(T1.attendance) FROM home_game AS T1 JOIN team AS T2 ON T1.team_id  =  T2.team_id_br WHERE T2.name  =  'Boston Red Stockings' AND T1.year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2010;

questions.question: What are the manager's first name, last name and id who won the most manager award?

questions.question: List the 3 highest salaries of the players in 2001?
